import json

# January 1940
jan_individual = 20561
jan_corporation = 25128

feb_corporation = 27503

# March 1940

mar_corporation = 298548

# Calculate ratios (individual/corporation)
jan_ratio = jan_individual / jan_corporation
feb_ratio = feb_individual / feb_corporation
mar_ratio = mar_individual / mar_corporation

print(f"March 1940: Individual={mar_individual}, Corporation={mar_corporation}, Ratio={mar_ratio}")

import numpy as np

months = np.array([1, 2, 3])
ratios = np.array([jan_ratio, feb_ratio, mar_ratio])

# Calculate slope using numpy
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(months, ratios, 1)

print(f"\nLinear regression results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Slope rounded to thousandths: {round(slope, 3)}")
EOF
